No verified step uses row 35 or row 216; no verified step is a standing row for a crouch step (no Batch 1 gate-note case — zero crouch-context verified steps). Review steps (row null, never played): 26, incl. 2,1,2,2,3,4-family step 6 candidate 225 (SOFT fail window [16.5,21.5] legR peak 6); 2,1,4,4,2,4,3-family step 7 candidate 234 (STANCE-SOFT crouch row for standing steps) and step 8 candidate 235 (STANCE-SOFT duck-dip row); b+2,4,4,4,4-family step 5 candidate 257 (duck-dip row for standing steps, STANCE-SOFT); 4,1 step 1 candidate 199 (SOFT fail window [3.5,7.5] legR peak 3, same evidence as Batch 3). Suspended steps (8): the eight step-1 prefixes "1" (1,2,3 / 1,2,3,4 / 1,2,4 / 1,3,2 / 1,3,2,1 / 1,3,2,1,4 / 1,3,4 / 1,d+3,d+4) — prefix move 1 is ROW-CHANGED 41->None; stale row 41 documented, never wired (jin row 41 is starts-airborne). The other two row-changed moves (1_r41, u+1,1~t3.jin.2) do not fall in Batch 4 scope. Job 4 joins: 33, none promoting (corrected join only; no-action on already-verified steps, rejected airborne/throw rows otherwise). Orphans: 2 (jin rows 85, 91 — same set as Batches 1-3). Most unmapped steps have NO candidate at all: their intermediate prefixes are T8-sourced with no T3 row, so the correct clips come from #988 Step 2 (original T8 refs) or future extraction, never from a T3 row recorded as correct. t7_motbin.method: Additive wiring: this section is NEW. No existing moveset entry was modified, reordered, or deleted. Existing playable moves keep their current anim_ref; motbin internal moves are NOT joined to playable input keys by name similarity, and no .mvl display walk was performed in this batch, so no existing anim_ref was overwritten on a guess. A future input-key join must be walk-verified from the cancel tables below.
t7_motbin.anim_ref_format: t7mot:<code>:0xXXXX where XXXX is the exact anim_ref from mot.bin; bank = anim_ref & 0xC000; clip_key = anim_ref - bank
t7_motbin.cancel_note: String continuations are ONLY these cancel rows from the file. move_id >= 0x8000 is an alias reference, not a move index, and must not be resolved silently. Runtime input keys stay 1/2/3/4; input_lp is display only (1=LP1, 2=RP2, 3=LK3, 4=RK4).
t7_motbin.damage_note: damage here is the motbin hit_condition damage for the move; it is NOT MOD damage and does NOT replace any existing t7.damage in this file.
t7_motbin.clip_blocker: 0x8000-bank clip bytes: the 0x8000 MOTA block is not present in tkdata repo files; clip bytes live only in pakchunk archives / live-game memory, which this Linux VM without GPU cannot run. Those moves carry clip_status BLOCKER_MAIN_MOTA_NOT_IN_TKDATA; their key is recorded, bytes were not guessed. 0x0000/0x4000 rows carry SOURCE_IDENTIFIED_BYTES_UNRESOLVED: source identified by bank, byte offsets not resolved in this batch.
t7_motbin.editor_note: Loader/editor consumption of this section (Move List Creator) is a follow-up for the game-code lane; this PR wires the data into the file at the correct integration point without rewriting game code.
